messages.author: 54d4981d6bf68eaf
messages.subject: custom shape coefficients
parts:
Hi all,

I was looking at the custom_shape parameter in the ectotherm function, and I have a question about the last two a and b parameter pairs.

What does it mean "sillhouette area normal to the sun"? I was guessing that sillhouette area perpendicular to the sun refers to the area exposed to the sun (when the sun is at the zenith?), but I am also unsure about that.

Thank you for your time!
Best!
Urtzi

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: custom shape coefficients
parts:
Hi Urtzi,

Yes it's the area receiving direct solar radiation when the animal has oriented itself perpendicular to the sun. The relevant code in the model is:

QSDIR=ABSAN*ASIL*(1.00-PDIF)*QNORM*(1.0-(SHADE/100.))

and ASIL will vary as a thermoregulatory strategy during basking in the model.

Or, if you are running it with live = 0, you can vary the input 'postur':

postur = 1, postural orientation to sun, 1 = perpendicular, 2 = parallel, 0 = half way between

All the best,
Mike

messages.subject: Re: custom shape coefficients
parts:
Hi Mike,

Thank you very much for your answer!

I see in the ectotherm function that when shape is set to 3 (lizard) or 4 (frog), the only parameter that changes is shape_c (although shape_b could also be relevant to reflect shape variation).

The point is that I am working on a project in which we are interested in exploring the consequences of shape variation in the biophysical properties of animals and we want to simulate organisms that vary widely in shape (e.g. snakes vs. lizards), or just in a subtle way (e.g. different snake species and different lizard species). One of the obvious parameters to change would be pct_cond, which could easily be estimated from alive/preserved specimens, or even photos. But I was wondering if there would be a way of estimating shape_b and shape_c (or custom_shape) parameter values based on e.g. photos. I would also like to know which approach (i.e. changing shape_b and shape_c or changing custom_shape) would be the best way to go to reflect shape variation.

Any suggestion will be much appreciated. Thanks a lot in advance.

All the best,
Urtzi

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: custom shape coefficients
parts:
Hi Urtzi,

You can certainly get the rough dimensions from photos if you're using a generic shape, but note that 'shape_a' etc. parameters are not used if shape > 3 (lizard, frog or custom) and instead parameters from regressions of measured surface area with size are used, e.g. the relevant Fortran code is pasted below from within the 'GEOM.f' subroutine for the frog and the custom shape. The measurements for the frog are described in Tracy's 1976 paper in Ecological Monographs.

All the best,
Mike

      IF(GEOMETRY.EQ.4)THEN
C      AREA OF LEOPARD FROG (C.R. TRACY 1976 ECOL. MONOG.)
       ATOTAL=(12.79*GMASS**.606)/10000.
       AV=(0.425*GMASS**.85)/10000.
       ATOT=ATOTAL
C      NORMAL AND POINTING @ SUN SILHOUETTE AREA: EQ'N 11 TRACY 1976
       ZEN=0.
       PCTN=1.38171E-06*ZEN**4-1.93335E-04*ZEN**3.+
     & 4.75761E-03*ZEN**2.-0.167912*ZEN+45.8228
       ASILN=PCTN*ATOT/100.
       ZEN=90.
       PCTP=1.38171E-06*ZEN**4-1.93335E-04*ZEN**3.+
     & 4.75761E-03*ZEN**2.-0.167912*ZEN+45.8228
       ASILP=PCTP*ATOT/100.
       AREA=ATOT
       AV=AREA*PTCOND
       AT=AREA*SKINT
       IF(PANT.GT.1)THEN
        AEFF=(SKINW+PMOUTH)*AREA-SKINW*AREA*PTCOND-SKINW*AREA*SKINT
       ELSE
        AEFF=SKINW*AREA-SKINW*AREA*PTCOND-SKINW*AREA*SKINT
       ENDIF       
      ENDIF

C     USER-DEFINED GEOMETRY
      IF(GEOMETRY.EQ.5) THEN
       ATOTAL=(CUSTOMGEOM(1)*GMASS**CUSTOMGEOM(2))/10000.
       AV=(CUSTOMGEOM(3)*GMASS**CUSTOMGEOM(4))/10000.
       ATOT=ATOTAL
       VOL=AMASS/ANDENS
C      CONDUCTION - RADIATION, ETC DIMENSION. ASSUME L=2D=4R1;
C      THEN VOL=PI*R1**2*L = 4*PI*R1**3
       R1=(VOL/(4.*PI))**(1./3.)
C      NORMAL AND POINTING @ SUN SILHOUETTE AREA: PORTER & TRACY 1984
C      USER MUST DEFINE MAX. SILHOUETTE AREA (NORMAL TO THE SUN)
       ASILN=(CUSTOMGEOM(5)*GMASS**CUSTOMGEOM(6))/10000.
C      USER MUST DEFINE MIN. SILHOUETTE AREA (POINTING TOWARD THE SUN)
       ASILP=(CUSTOMGEOM(7)*GMASS**CUSTOMGEOM(8))/10000.
       AREA=ATOT
       AV=AREA*PTCOND
       AT=AREA*SKINT
       IF(PANT.GT.1)THEN
        AEFF=(SKINW+PMOUTH)*AREA-SKINW*AREA*PTCOND-SKINW*AREA*SKINT
       ELSE
        AEFF=SKINW*AREA-SKINW*AREA*PTCOND-SKINW*AREA*SKINT
       ENDIF
      ENDIF
